data.description: A protean's form is not fixed.  Once per day as a standard action, a protean may change shape into any Small, Medium, or Large animal, elemental, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, ooze, plant, or vermin.  A protean can resume its true form as a free action, and when it does so, it gainst the effects of a heal spell (CL %1).
